--son of शन्तनु; Grandsire of the पाण्डवस् and गन्गा. The best of Bharatas, the foremost of the Vasus, and versed in dharma: Learned, self-controlled, and devoted to Hari. His prowess was praised even by परशु- राम. Leader of a thousand legions, called सहस्राणी;
1: भा. IX. २२. १९-20;

. ३५.
heard a legend from वसिष्ठ as to who was a नग्न।
१३: Ib. III. १७. 7.

--the invincible king of Vidarbha, capital of कुण्डिन (Berar);
1: भा.

.
was stationed by जरासन्ध on the northern side during the siege of Gomanta;
3: भा. X. ५२. ११[15].
went to the स्यमन्तपञ्चक for the solar eclipse.
4: Ib. X. ८२. १५.
